name: Jones Plastic & Engineering
old_description: Founded in 1961, Jones Plastic & Engineering has spent decades building one of North America’s most integrated plastic manufacturing operations. From pioneering gas-assist injection molding in the early 1990s to operating a dedicated robotic paint and hydrographics facility in Juarez, Mexico, Jones Plastic combines deep process knowledge with broad manufacturing capability.
about:
Jones Plastic & Engineering was founded in 1961 in Louisville, Kentucky, by Harry and Larry Jones as a single-machine operation producing whiskey bottle caps. The family-owned business, now headed by the second and third generations of the Jones family, is based in Jeffersontown, Kentucky, and operates nine facilities across the United States and Mexico.

The company provides integrated plastic manufacturing services, including product development, tooling, injection molding (65 to 3,150 tons across five facilities), robotic paint, hydrographics, assembly, and testing. A dedicated 90,000-square-foot paint and hydrographics plant in Juárez, Mexico, houses a 25,000-square-foot clean-room paint line with FANUC robots, RFID-controlled rack systems, and a 1.3-meter hydrographic dip tank. An in-house 3D printing lab runs FDM and PolyJet systems for functional prototypes and short-run injection molded samples. Total manufacturing space approaches 1.6 million square feet with roughly 3,000 employees.

Jones Plastic serves automotive, appliance, powersports, outdoor products, consumer goods, and industrial and defense markets, supplying components and assemblies to North American OEMs. The company also operates Rev-A-Shelf, a wholly owned subsidiary that manufactures residential cabinet storage and organizational products.

The firm pioneered gas-assist injection molding in the early 1990s and emphasizes an engineering-first approach, using solid modeling, CAE simulation, and rapid prototyping to validate designs before tooling. Integrating molding, finishing, and assembly under one supply chain aims to reduce freight, handling, and coordination costs. Quality management is ISO 9001 certified.
